concepts.gloss_en: The World to Come (olam ha-ba / alma d'atei); the eschatological reality whose essence is attaining knowledge of His divinity
The glory OF the World to Come — a distinct construct (kavod as head), the honor attained through a second repentance; not the World to Come itself

members.note: different construct head (כבוד); a state/attribute about olam ha-ba, not olam ha-ba itself

concepts.gloss_en: A semblance/foretaste OF the World to Come — the experience (in this world) of recognizing all events are for one's good; a taste of, not identical to, the World to Come

members.note: different construct head (מעין = 'a taste/semblance of'); denotes a this-worldly foretaste, not olam ha-ba itself

notes: All three kept separate per rule 4 (different construct heads; an attribute/foretaste of X is not X). Rule 1 favors under-merge.
